newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian central bank to cut key refinancing rate.
newsitem.headline: Latvian central bank to cut key refinancing rate.

text.p: Latvia's central bank on Thursday said it was to cut its refinancing rate to seven percent from eight percent, effective from February 14.
The rate is the minimum rate at which banks can obtain two-week funds from the central bank and is a key market rate.
The bank said in a statement that the rate would be cut as rates on government T-bills have fallen to four to six percent thanks to the increased presence of foreign investors.
It also noted that the yearly inflation rate fell in January to 11.4 percent from 13.1 percent in December and that the interbank market rates were also falling.
The bank last cut its refinancing rate to eight percent on January 31.
